block.leaf_buffer_basis: section 4.4 allocates two RE8 endpoints per eight-tile cluster, each with 4 KiB buffering; TILE_LANES x SLOT_ELEMS x LEAVES x 4 B is that buffer and the vehicle's is exactly 4,096 B
block.why_it_exists: results/rtl/abi3_boundary_chain.json established by elaboration that nothing in the design drove ot_a3_tree_endpoint_fp32's leaf port from ot_a3_tile64's partial port.  This is that block

cases_declared.name: b2_e1_lockstep
cases_declared.note: B = 2, one element per lane: the decode geometry (rows 1, cols 64) the two-tile chain runs

cases_declared.name: b8_e1_lockstep
cases_declared.note: B = 8, the endpoint's full leaf count

cases_declared.name: b1_e1_lockstep
cases_declared.note: B = 1: a single K-block passes the leaf through (the endpoint's m = 1 path)

cases_declared.name: b5_e1_lockstep
cases_declared.note: B = 5, an odd leaf count: the carry rule at every level

cases_declared.name: b3_e2_lockstep
cases_declared.note: B = 3 with two elements per lane: the whole 4 KiB buffer

cases_declared.name: b8_e2_lockstep
cases_declared.note: B = 8 and two elements: the buffer at capacity

cases_declared.name: b4_e1_perlane
cases_declared.note: B = 4 presented one lane per cycle: the lanes' leaf stores are independent, so a staggered producer changes nothing

cases_declared.name: b2_e2_perlane
cases_declared.note: B = 2, two elements, one lane per cycle

cases_declared.name: b3_e1_base
cases_declared.note: a nonzero op_out_base: the element is the offset from the K-block's own base

cases_declared.name: fault_addr
cases_declared.note: a partial outside its K-block window

cases_declared.name: fault_kblock
cases_declared.note: a K-block index at or above B

cases_declared.name: fault_incomplete
cases_declared.note: a slot ready without all B leaves

cases_declared.name: refuse_blocks_wide
cases_declared.note: B above the endpoint's leaf count: the chained upper tree is not this block's business

cases_declared.name: refuse_elems_wide
cases_declared.note: a window wider than the 4 KiB leaf buffer

does_not_establish.any_boundary_latency: no dependent-boundary cycle count is measured here.  The two-tile chain measurement is a separate campaign
does_not_establish.physical_realisability: simulation says nothing about area, timing or power; no routed record of this block exists
does_not_establish.the_chained_upper_tree: B above LEAVES is refused rather than chained; composing stage-2 endpoints is the engine controller's business and no RTL for it exists
does_not_establish.the_general_window_permutation: the collector emits slots in ascending (lane, element) order.  Which activation element of a CONSUMER a slot becomes is the operand H-tree's address rule, which section 4.4 leaves unwritten

establishes: that the collector presents ot_a3_tile64's partial port to ot_a3_tree_endpoint_fp32 in the tree's leaf order -- leaf k is K-block k of one output element -- with dense ascending tags, and that every root the endpoint then retires equals the exact AM-E1 reference re8_chain over those partials
that the transposition holds whether the producer presents all 64 lanes on one cycle (the tile's lockstep) or one lane per cycle, and at B = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 8 leaves
that the 4 KiB leaf buffer is a sized resource: a window wider than it holds is refused, not wrapped
six distinct fail-closed modes, each reported with the lowest faulting lane and the slot

reference.leaf_vectors: checked by each checker directly against pc_part.hex: vector v = slot (lane, e) with lane = v / elems and e = v mod elems, leaf k = the partial of K-block k
reference.roots: tools/am_e1_lane_reference.py::re8_chain, asserted equal to pairwise_tree (which am_e1_lane_reference asserts against runtime/sim/engines/reduction.py::ordered_sum in PAIRWISE_TREE)
